newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's MBA forms trusteeship of up to $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's MBA forms trusteeship of up to $50 mln.

text.p: Argentina's MBA Banco de Inversiones SA has been authorized to issue debt securities in in dollars for up to $50 million, constituting a trusteeship, the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange said Wednesday.
The debt issue constitutes a financial trusteeship called Tifon 3, as part of a previously announced debt program of up to $300 million, it added.
Net proceeds of the issue will be chanelled to buy debt securities in dollars issued by Salomon Inc.
The issue has a variable yield on the basis of a "Tifon index". The yield is obtained from the index's final value minus the initial value (100), with the result multiplied by 1.55.
In case the yield reaches a cap of 225, the issue will pay instead a fix amount of $62 for each $100 invested.
MBA Banco de Inversiones is 50 percent owned by Argentina's Merchant Bankers Asociados and 50 percent by Salomon Brothers.
